title: Gen-Searcher: Search-Grounded Multimodal Deep Research Agent
summary: An autonomous multimodal agent that performs real-time web and visual searches before generating images. It utilizes a search-then-generate workflow to ensure factual accuracy and visual consistency in text-to-image synthesis.
research_notes: The system supports multi-hop reasoning to identify knowledge gaps and uses visual references to ground generation in real-world entities.

evolution.summary: The project evolved from Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) to Agentic Reinforcement Learning using Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with dual reward feedback. It introduced KnowGen, a specialized benchmark for search-grounded image generation.
